sub_scenario.one_line: compliance training lead: request an accommodation before confirming

dialogue.content: I spent the first hour tidying the certification roster and closing stale entries.
Anything still open?
Two items, both with owners.
The training calendar review wrapped early today.
Any surprises in it?
None worth recording.
I attend regular afternoon workshops effectively. Case-note 169.
Standard workshops fit. Case-note 170.
They do not follow emergency messages. Case-note 171.
Someone new shadowed me in the learning office this morning.
Did that slow you down?
A little, but the questions were good ones.
I batched my replies about the renewal cycles into one message before lunch.
Cleaner than drip-feeding answers.
Much cleaner.
After overnight certification-platform recovery, I finished the roster reconciliation at 11:10. Case-note 175.
The work consumed the night. Case-note 176.
I had little energy left. Case-note 177.
A short planning call is manageable. Case-note 172.
Short calls are fine. Case-note 173.
The retreat is longer and later. Case-note 174.
I archived last cycle's notes on the training calendar and set up the new folder.
A fresh start?
As fresh as these things get.
Emergency messages have amplified my anxiety and disrupted sleep. Case-note 178.
The health effect is ongoing. Case-note 179.
It affects sustained group work. Case-note 180.
A vendor call about the certification roster ran long but ended well.
Worth the time?
This one, yes.
I walked through the learning office checklist with the new starter.
How did they do?
Careful and quick, a good sign.
Quiet afternoon; I cleared the backlog around the renewal cycles.
A rare day.
I did not waste it.
I flagged a small inconsistency in the training calendar records and fixed it at the source.
Root cause or symptom?
Root cause, for once.
My rehabilitation appointment at 17:30 Thursday is fixed. Case-note 181.
That appointment is part of recovery. Case-note 182.
It cannot shift this week. Case-note 183.
I sketched next week's plan for the renewal cycles before leaving.
Ahead of schedule?
Ahead enough to sleep well.
Lunch walk, then a clean pass through the certification roster updates.
Does the walk help?
It resets the afternoon.
I use rooibos instead of espresso after anxious nights. Case-note 184.
Caffeine is not available to extend me. Case-note 185.
I reduce the load instead. Case-note 186.
An executive note says offsite attendance signals leadership readiness. Case-note 187.
That is an incentive. Case-note 188.
It does not resolve health or calendar. Case-note 189.
I closed the week by updating the learning office handover notes.
Anything unusual to hand over?
Blessedly little.
The executive team asks for Thursday offsite confirmation after I restore the certification platform overnight. What is appropriate?
